openwashdata is a community that publishes WASH datasets as documented, citable R data packages, and teaches the skills to do it.

::: {.owd-actions} [Explore the data](pages/gallery/data/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Join the course](pages/academy/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline} ::: ::: {#subscribe}

::: ::: {.owd-number-item}

::: ::: ::: ::: ::: {.owd-section} ## Data

Every dataset comes as an R data package with a website, a data dictionary, a license and a citation.

::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
Malawi, February 2026 mwgroundwaterdata

Malawi Groundwater Monitoring Time-Series Dataset (2024–2025)

 Malawi, February 2026 mwefloodresponse

Malawi Emergency Flood Response Water Point Survey (2019–2020)

 Malawi, September 2025 waterpointfunctionality

Water Point Functionality - Malawi, 2022
``` ::: ::: [See all 50 datasets](pages/gallery/data/index.qmd){.owd-more} ::: ::: {.owd-tint} ::: {.owd-section} ## Dataset of the month ::: {.owd-dotm} ::: {.owd-dotm-text} **jmpdata** holds the sanitation data behind the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme estimates: 26,926 survey data points and 424,575 modelled estimates for 232 countries and territories. The chart shows the survey data points per year, the thin base under a large body of estimates. [Open jmpdata](https://openwashdata.github.io/jmpdata){.owd-more} ::: ![Bar chart of survey-level sanitation data points in the JMP raw data per year, from 1991 to 2024](mockups/card-jmpdata.png) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.owd-band} ::: {.owd-band-inner} ## Get the dataset of the month in your inbox

Once a month we send one dataset, one story from the community, and what is new. No more than that.

::: ::: ::: {.owd-section} ## Learn

ds4owd, our free online course, teaches WASH professionals data science in R. Two cohorts have graduated so far.

[About the course](pages/academy/index.qmd){.owd-more} ### Recent events ::: {#recent-events} ::: [All events](pages/events/index.qmd){.owd-more} ::: ::: {.owd-tint} ::: {.owd-section} ## Read
